title: The Man Who Blasphemed the Lord's Name
description: A man with an Egyptian father and an Israelite mother blasphemed and cursed God's name during a fight in the camp. He was held in custody until the Lord gave judgment, and then he was stoned outside the camp. This event became the basis for the law that anyone who blasphemes the Name must die, establishing the principle of 'eye for eye' and confirming that the same law applies to both native-born Israelites and foreigners.
